title: Auto-Trigger Cards
description: Every action card in a player's hand has a switch, in the player sheet and in the reaction window, that decides whether the card is offered when its window opens or declined without asking. The setting is held by the server.

shots.heading: Default: every card is offered
shots.caption: The private hand in the player sheet. A green tick beside each action card means the card is offered whenever its trigger happens.

shots.heading: Two cards set to Never
shots.caption: Direct Hit and Skilled Retreat show a red cross. A click is sent to the server (set_reaction_mode) and the cross is drawn from the state update that comes back. When the window of such a card opens, the game declines it without asking, so the player is not interrupted.

shots.heading: The switch explains itself
shots.caption: Hovering the switch shows what a click does. The tooltip is drawn by the capture helper from the button's title text, because browsers draw native tooltips outside the page.

shots.heading: The same switch in the reaction window
shots.caption: Under each card the window offers: "Never offer Sabotage again this game". It is the same setting as in the player sheet.

shots.heading: Ticked from the window
shots.caption: Ticking sends the setting to the server and, when this is the only card on offer, passes the window. The box shows what the server answered.

shots.heading: A skipped window says so
shots.caption: When every card of a window is on Never, no window opens. The corner toast names the card so the player knows why nothing was asked.

notes.title: Who sees it
notes.text: Only the owner of the hand gets the switch, and only that seat's clients receive the setting. Other players and spectators never see it.

notes.title: Scope
notes.text: The setting is per card name (every copy of Sabotage at once) and per game. It is saved with the game, so it survives a server restart and an undo.

notes.title: What Never does
notes.text: The window of that card is declined for the player and the decline is recorded like any other answer, so replays and restarts reproduce the game. A window that also holds another card still opens, without the Never card.

notes.title: Capture setup
notes.text: The captures run against a mocked server that behaves like the real one for set_reaction_mode (modes held on the server, returned in the seat's state update). The server side is covered by Rust tests with a real game.
